# Close

Close is a CRM platform designed to help businesses manage and streamline their sales processes, including calling, email automation, and predictive dialers.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/close/.

## Actions

- **Create Call**: Creates a new call record in close.com.
- **Create Lead**: This tool creates a new lead in close crm.
- **Create SMS Message**: This tool creates a new sms message in close.
- **Create Task**: This tool creates a new task in close.com.
- **Delete Call**: This tool allows you to delete a specific call activity in close.com.
- **Get Notes** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of note activities from close.
